phase5e_rf.full: Earlier rectified-flow dose predictor before the later correction stages
phase5e_rf.meaning: The frozen upstream model actually used by the recovered system. It is not claimed to be an untouched initial Practical model.

phase9d_plus.full: Dose predictor with learned multiplicative and additive correction
phase9d_plus.meaning: An intermediate stage of the previous system, before the additional calibration and final refinement.

phase9g.full: Frozen calibrated dose predictor shared by the compared correction methods
phase9g.meaning: Provides the starting dose prediction used to define the new correction target. It is a learned prediction, not dose-to-water.

phase10d_strict.full: Final Practical dose-prediction system with falloff-aware bounded refinement
phase10d_strict.meaning: The recovered previous final system. Its final refinement head used the corrected training/validation case split; this does not certify the entire upstream history as blind.

new_residual_rf.full: Rectified flow matching with direct signed-residual prediction
new_residual_rf.meaning: Predicts one correction field that can contain positive and negative values, then adds it to the shared calibrated prediction. This is not a direct-regression baseline.

new_hjd_rf.plot:
New: separate positive/
negative corrections
(flow matching)
new_hjd_rf.full: Rectified flow matching with Hahn–Jordan decomposition of the signed residual
new_hjd_rf.meaning: Uses two spatial flow fields and predicted component magnitudes to reconstruct a positive correction minus a nonnegative negative-correction magnitude, then adds the signed result to the shared calibrated prediction.
